newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 2.955 billion yuan from 3.057 billion with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was less active with head offices of state banks staying on the sidelines with money supply ample thanks to a sharp increase in individual bank deposits since the start of this year.
"The state banks did not want to build major positions because they have enough money on hand," one trader said.
Non-banking financial institutions including securities houses were the major traders with many borrowing money to bid for a large number of new domestic A share issues this week.
Traders said the rates would move narrowly in active trading in the near term.
